reviews.text: A fun and unique Chongqing experience Liziba Monorail Station is one of Chongqing’s most famous and unusual sights. Seeing a train pass directly through a residential building is surprising and fascinating. It’s not a place where you spend a long time, but it’s worth a short stop for photos and to experience how creative Chongqing’s urban design is. The viewing platform is well organised, though it can get crowded at peak times. Simple, quick, and very memorable—great for first-time visitors to Chongqing.

The famous “train through the building” in Chongqing is an interesting and unique sight that attracts many visitors. It’s definitely a must-visit spot for photo taking, as the view of the train passing directly through the apartment block is unlike anything else. The good part is trains come every few minutes, so you don’t need to wait too long to catch the moment. However, the area can be quite crowded with tourists all aiming for the same shots, which may limit your angles. Overall, it’s worth seeing at least once, but be prepared for some crowding and limited photo space.

The Liziba Viewing Platform is one of those must-see spots in Chongqing where you truly appreciate the city’s unique engineering and urban design. Standing on the platform, you get a clear view of the light rail line literally passing through a residential building — something you won’t find in many other cities around the world. It’s a short stop but definitely worth the visit. The trains run frequently, so you won’t have to wait long before catching the surreal sight of them gliding smoothly through the building. The platform itself is well-maintained, with ample space for visitors to take photos and enjoy the spectacle. This place perfectly sums up Chongqing’s reputation as a city of hills, bridges, and innovative urban planning. A quick visit, but one that leaves a lasting impression.

The train can be viewed from lots of places in this area. The main viewing platform is very crowded and busy with a lot of people selling photography services. You can view the train without crowds from the mall next to the platform and from various streets within 5/10 minutes walk. Trains come frequently so there's plenty of picture opportunities.
If you’re a tourist, of course you’ll visit the Liziba Station 🚉 . Much ado about nothing but it does add to the vibe that Chonqing is a modern cyberpunk tech city.

The Chongqing Liziba train going through a building is the most chaotic yet deeply efficient thing I’ve ever seen 🚆🏢. Like, who looked at a skyscraper and said, “Yeah, that’s a vibe — just drive the train through it”? Absolute urban legend behaviour. It’s the perfect symbol of modern life: rent too high, traffic too bad, so public transport just said “fine, I’ll make my own shortcut.” Somewhere in that building, someone’s making coffee while a literal train passes their living room every 10 minutes and they’re just unfazed — “Oh that? Yeah, that’s just Line 2.” ☕💨 Only in Chongqing, where the trains don’t go around problems — they go through them.

Instagram worthy place. Go here if you must take that perfect shot of the train going into the building. Be prepared for the crowds and souvenir sellers trying to bug you to buy their stuff. Liziba is noted as China's first light rail overhead station built through and packed with a block of flats on Chongqing Rail Transit 2 (CRT 2).

Chongqing’s challenging terrain leaves little space for wide tracks, so engineers took a creative approach by integrating the train station directly into a residential building. Surprisingly, it remains remarkably quiet. Trains pass without honking, and locals often remark that it’s even quieter than the hum of a refrigerator.
Its actually not that amazing nor entertaining because the land contour of the area so the the city development following and adapt the condition to provide best building structures

An unusual tourist attraction, the metro station inside a building. You can go up to the station inside the building and taking a lift. There is also a bookstore inside the building where you can see the train entering the building.

the train 🚂 is astonishing to watch. 😍 it is very crowded at Liziba and people are all taking pictures. don't forget to take care of your belongings and hold tight to your families since there is soo many people you might lost within the crowd.

The Liziba Station is a unique and the most famous light rail station in Chongqing. Big crowd of local and foreign tourists come here every day to see monorail train go through a residential high-rise building and stop at the station inside. The viewing platform on the ground level is specially built for people to take photos and videos of the train moving in and out of the building. It is one of the must-visit places in Chongqing.

Tucked into the mountainous heart of Chongqing, Liziba Station is one of those places that makes you stop and say, “Only in China.” It’s not just a train station—it’s a marvel of urban ingenuity. Watching the monorail glide *through* a residential building is surreal, like something out of a sci-fi movie. But it’s real, and it works. The engineering is flawless, the timing precise, and the whole thing feels like a quiet celebration of human creativity. Chongqing itself is a city that demands stamina. It’s vast, vertical, and full of life. The hills, the heat, the endless staircases—it’s not for the faint of heart or light of wallet. But if you’re willing to put in the effort, the rewards are immense. The food alone is worth the trip—spicy, bold, unforgettable. And the people? Warm, proud, and full of stories. Standing at Liziba, watching the train disappear into the building, I couldn’t help but feel a deep admiration for our Chinese brothers and sisters. They’ve built cities that don’t just function—they astonish. Chongqing is a testament to what’s possible when vision meets determination. It’s not always easy to navigate, and it might wear you out, but it’s absolutely worth it. If you ever find yourself in China, don’t skip Chongqing. And definitely don’t miss Liziba. It’s a small moment in a big city, but one that stays with you long after the train has passed.
It's another must see place in Chongqing. Train tunneling intonthe building complex. The station is Liziba Station. Pretty sure it's look better at night.

This fad is something which has been blown out of proportion. It is just a train running into the station which is situated in a building. Due to the undulating land, it is not on the ground floor. Let me know if you’d like to add travel tips or how to get there!

Liziba LRT Station 李子坝轻轨站 Liziba station is one of the hottest Instagram spots in Chongqing. And no wonder. Hundreds of tourists hang around just to snap a photo or video of the train going silently right through the residential building. Not to worry. This Chongqing Light Rail Transit on line 2 is built separately and at the same time as the residential building. The support structures of the building are separated by about 20 centimetres from the pillars of the rail. What's more, the train runs on rubber tires with air suspension on them. Therefore, the building does not feel the intensity of the vibrations coming from the train. This is how Chongqing work around the mountainous terrain of the city, nicknamed Mountain City. It's amazing how an 'ordinary' neighbourhood light rail station used by Chongqing residents had become such a hotspot for tourists 😂 🧭Location : Liziba LRT Station 李子坝轻轨站

Liziba Station-A Place Where Light Trains Disappear in Block of Flats in Chongqing.. Around 400 households live in the 19-story building. The station only takes up floors 6 and 7, so everyone else lives peacefully above or below the tracks Surprisingly quiet! Trains and Almost zero shaking Who came up with this crazy idea? It was a team decision in 1999. The train company and the building company didn’t want to fight over the land, so they decided to be neighbours and share the same spot

O grande destaque aqui é ver o metrô passando literalmente por dentro do prédio, algo que impressiona mesmo depois de vários vídeos na internet. Ao vivo, a sensação é ainda mais impactante. Qualquer horário do dia tem bastante gente para ver de perto, tirar fotos e gravar vídeos, além de oferecer uma vista interessante do entorno urbano de Chongqing. Vale a pena visitar tanto de dia quanto à noite, já que a iluminação da cidade deixa o cenário ainda mais especial. É um daqueles lugares que mostram como a cidade consegue unir engenharia, arquitetura e cotidiano de forma única. Recomendo muito a visita para quem gosta de experiências urbanas fora do comum.

reviews.authorName: ธวัชชัย อารีย์
reviews.text: รถไฟทะลุตึก เป็นจุดเด่นที่ทำให้สถานีกลายเป็นแลนด์มาร์กที่มีชื่อเสียงระดับโลก คือสถานีหลีจื่อป้า (Liziba) เป็นสถานีรถไฟโมโนเรลบน รถไฟฟ้าฉงชิ่ง สาย 2 ในประเทศจีนที่เปิดให้บริการเมื่อวันที่ 18 มิถุนายน พ.ศ. 2548 (ค.ศ. 2005) สถานีแห่งนี้มีชื่อเสียงโด่งดังจากการเป็นส่วนหนึ่งของอาคารที่พักอาศัยสูง 19 ชั้น โดยรางรถไฟวิ่งผ่านชั้นที่ 6-8 ซึ่งเป็นผลมาจากการออกแบบอย่างชาญฉลาดเพื่อแก้ปัญหาข้อจำกัดด้านพื้นที่ในเมืองฉงชิ่งที่เป็นภูเขา ปัจจุบันสถานีหลีจื่อป้าเป็นสถานที่ท่องเที่ยวที่ได้รับความนิยมอย่างมาก ดึงดูดนักท่องเที่ยวจากทั่วโลกให้มาชมและถ่ายภาพรถไฟวิ่งผ่านอาคาร

Это место - настоящая жемчужина городского пейзажа, где можно увидеть захватывающее зрелище, как поезд метро проходит сквозь жилые дома. Нет ничего более захватывающего, чем наблюдать это невероятное шоу технологии и архитектуры. Каждый раз, когда поезд прокатывается мимо, это вызывает удивление и восхищение, ощущение, что ты становишься частью удивительного городского ландшафта. Если вы еще не посетили это место, я настоятельно рекомендую сделать это - это удивительное зрелище оставит вас в восторге и восхищении. Единственное, очень много людей , поэтому занимайте места поудобней!

Der Bahnhof Liziba ist ein Bahnsteigbahnhof der Chongqing Rail Transit Line (CRT) 2. Er befindet sich an der Kreuzung zwischen New Jialing Road und Guihuayuan Road im Bezirk Yuzhong der Stadt Chongqing. Im Norden verläuft der Jialing-Fluss. Es ist schon sehr ungewöhnlich , wenn ein Zug in ein Haus fährt, aber in diesem Haus ist ja eine Bahnstation ein Bahnhof im siebten Stock. Es zieht sehr viele Leute an und die fotografieren. Es ist schon etwas ungewöhnlich, aber es ist sehr schön anzusehen und Liziba ist bekannt für die Bahnstrecke, die durch einen Wohnblock führt. Für die Einheimischen ist Liziba tatsächlich viel mehr als nur ein Bahnhof. Er ist die Heimat des Alltagslebens der Menschen, der Erinnerungen an historische Kriege. Der CRT-Bahnhof Liziba wurde vor dem Nationalfeiertag als Chinas 70-jähriges Wachstumsdenkmal aufgeführt. Auch viele Touristen werden angezogen von diesem Schauspiel.
